models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Registered user accounts for managing personal todo items.

This model stores unique member identities for end users of the Todo application. Each record captures essential account details required for secure authentication, session management, and privacy enforcement per user. All registered users are uniquely identified by email, with password hashing for credential security. Users may create, update, complete, and delete their own todos, with strict enforcement that no user may access or modify another account's todos. The table supports account recovery and compliance with data erasure policies. Admin accounts are managed separately to preserve strong privilege separation.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and account notifications. Enforced as unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed representation of the user's password. Plaintext values are never stored or processed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last update to the user's account data.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for GDPR/account deletion and recovery workflows.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
Session records for authenticated user activity tracking.

This subsidiary table logs all active and historical login sessions for each user, enabling secure authentication state management, audit trails, and session expiry enforcement. It captures the context of each login, including IP, originating URL, and referrer information, as well as lifecycle timestamps. Each session references its owner user and is never shared across users. Sessions may expire naturally or be terminated for security reasons. The table enforces auditability and supports forensic analysis during security events or account changes.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: References the unique user who owns this session. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the application entry point for the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL initiating sign-in session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Set when the session naturally concludes or is terminated.

models.name: todo_app_admins
models.description:
System administrator accounts with global oversight authority.

This model manages all privileged identities authorized to oversee, support, and manage the entire Todo application, including all user and todo records. Admin accounts are strictly segregated from regular user accounts to preserve least-privilege policy and support regulatory compliance. Each admin is identified by a unique email, with a securely hashed password for exclusive authentication. Deletion and modification actions by admins are audited, and extended account management privileges are restricted to this class. Suitable for future extension to audit or multi-role administration.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for administrator authentication. Must be unique across all admins.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential for administrator authentication. Plaintext passwords are never stored.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the administrator account.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the administrator record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for compliance or admin removal events.

models.name: todo_app_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session tracking for administrator authentication events.

This model logs all authentication sessions for administrators only, capturing the connection context and session lifecycle details for compliance and audit purposes. Each session is strictly tied to a unique admin account and includes IP, href, referrer, and timestamps. The subsidiary stance enforces that sessions are managed through admin workflows, and each login event is auditable for security reviews. No overlap occurs with user session management, preserving strong privilege boundaries. Supports account lockout, session expiry, and future multifactor authentication enhancements.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: References the unique administrator who owns this session. {@link todo_app_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrator session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Entry URL for admin session sign-in.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that originated the admin session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session initiation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking the end or expiry of the administrator's session.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Primary business entity for all todo tasks in the application.

Represents an individual todo item uniquely owned by a single user ({@link todo_app_users}). Each todo captures the required title, optional description, and full set of business lifecycle states (active, completed, deleted) via the status field and corresponding timestamps. Enforces unique todo titles among a user's active items, supports optional due date, and maintains full audit fields for creation, modification, completion, and soft deletion. Todos are strictly private and accessible only to the user and system administrators; all visibility and permissions are managed at the application layer. All state transitions (completion, deletion, recovery) are reflected in status and timestamp columns; permanent erasure after retention period is carried out by application logic. The model allows efficient queries on ownership, state, and business constraints, and is ready for enterprise-scale extensions (archiving, snapshot/audit, future features).

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo. References the primary key in the users table. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required, user-defined name of todo item. Must be unique among active todos for the same user. Maximum 100 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional, user-supplied description of the todo. Maximum 1000 characters. May be null if the user chooses not to enter details.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the todo. One of: 'active', 'completed', 'deleted'. Transitions controlled by user actions and business rules.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for task completion. Null if no due date is set. Must be a future date at the time of entry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of todo creation (UTC, immutable). Set once at row insertion.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to title, description, due date, or other editable fields. Updated automatically on modification.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when todo was marked as completed. Only set when status='completed'; otherwise null.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when todo was deleted (soft delete). Set when status transitions to 'deleted', otherwise null. Used for retention/erasure rules.
